probe.question: The Suzuki conditions campaign has been running a while and the last few points went backwards. Do I keep pushing or reset?
forbids_claims: a surrogate model implied where none was fitted
a trend claimed without reading the runs in their recorded order
probe.direction: Read the campaign in time order first. There are two defensible paths — reason from the series, or optimize over it — and the answer should say which it took and why. A few points going backwards is not automatically a signal; whether it is depends on the spread of what came before.
